svg.title: Isocline, layer by layer
svg.desc: Concept drawing of Isocline's architecture as an exploded stack. Top to bottom: Web UI and SDK/CLI clients; the FastAPI API; PostgreSQL with pgvector (the authoritative state, highlighted) and Redis; Celery workers and Beat; and the effects tier of model providers, tools and MCP servers, and the Python sandbox. Sizes are illustrative.
